title: Five decisions to make before a campaign goes live
hook: The best time to decide when to cut an ad is before it goes live.
caption:
The best time to decide when to cut an ad is before it goes live.

After launch, everyone reads the numbers their own way, and the review turns into a debate.

Five decisions settle it in advance: what the ad is testing, what it is compared with, the one number that judges it, how long it runs, and what happens if it wins or loses.

The last slide is a card you can fill in for each campaign. Save it.

Want help setting these rules for your account? Link in bio. Follow @galvor.ai.

slides.headline: *5 decisions* to make before a campaign goes live
slides.sub: Made after launch, they turn into arguments.

slides.headline: After launch, everyone *reads the numbers their way*
slides.body:
One person wants to give it more time. Another wants it switched off today.

Rules agreed in advance settle that before the review begins.

slides.headline: What are we *testing*, and against what?
items: The one thing this ad changes: hook, cast, offer or look
The ad it will be compared with

slides.headline: What counts as a *result*?
items: The one number that decides, such as cost per order
How long it runs before anyone judges it

slides.headline: What happens *next*, either way?
items: If it wins: what we scale and what we brief next
If it loses: what we cut and what we stop briefing

slides.headline: Rules first. *Results second.*
